component.name: NX Wisp
component.summary: A creature that lives on your desktop

description.p: NX Wisp is a desktop companion for KDE Plasma on Wayland. She walks around your screen, sits on your windows, watches what your machine is doing, thinks with a local language model, and talks to you — and she gets out of the way completely the moment you need your GPU back.

Everything happens on your machine. There is no telemetry and no cloud inference. A five-tier resource governor unloads her brain and moves her rendering to the integrated GPU the moment a game or a VR session starts, and gives it all back when you are done.
Requires KDE Plasma 6 on Wayland and a Vulkan-capable GPU.
